name: page-layout
title: Page Layout
description: A page's column: centered at a dense (73.75rem), wide (90rem) or full width, with page gutters and gap-section between blocks, a header slot, and a workspace variant without padding for app-like screens.
docs: `<PageLayout header={<PageHeader … />}>…</PageLayout>`. It renders a `div` by default, because the app shell often owns `<main>`; pass `as="main"` when the page is the main content, and it renders `<main id="main" tabIndex={-1}>` (pass `id` to change it) so a SkipLink reaches it. The SkipLink focuses it by id without touching the URL, so hash-routed apps keep their route; with a custom `id`, pass the same value as the SkipLink's `target`. It is never a live region: announce changes from the component that changes (an Alert with `live`, a DataState). `variant="workspace"` drops the gutters and the width cap, for screens that lay out their own panes.
